# Scenario: compose pull failure after a compose change writes
# container_deploy_failed (project + containers + error; empty added/removed/
# started omitted), keeps .apply_pending, and leaves the prior container
# running (README Events / apply pending).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: container deploy failed baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: healthy stack ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'container deployed project=e2e-cdepfail containers=web added=web removed=\(none\) started=\(none\)'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepfail-web
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9964/
stdout 'CDEP_FAIL_V1'

exec sh -c 'docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra_e2e-cdepfail-web > $WORK/old-cid'
exec sh -c 'test -s $WORK/old-cid'
exec sh -c 'cp "$HOME/.events" "$WORK/events.after-first"'

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.bad.yml dev/e2e-cdepfail/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: missing image tag to fail pull'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 2: pull fails → event + pending; prior container untouched ---
# Host still has running web → empty added/removed/started (logged as (none)).
exec apinfra
stderr 'container deploy failed project=e2e-cdepfail containers=web added=\(none\) removed=\(none\) started=\(none\)'
stderr 'WARN start project=e2e-cdepfail'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.events
exec sh -c 'grep container_deploy_failed "$HOME/.events" | tail -n1 > "$WORK/fail.event"'
grep '"project":"e2e-cdepfail"' $WORK/fail.event
grep '"containers":"web"' $WORK/fail.event
grep '"error"' $WORK/fail.event
grep 'compose pull' $WORK/fail.event
! grep '"added"' $WORK/fail.event
! grep '"removed"' $WORK/fail.event
! grep '"started"' $WORK/fail.event

exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-cdepfail/.apply_pending
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepfail-web
exec sh -c 'test "$(docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra_e2e-cdepfail-web)" = "$(cat $WORK/old-cid)"'
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9964/
stdout 'CDEP_FAIL_V1'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
dockerComposePullTimeout=30s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-cdepfail
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9964
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-cdepfail/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=CDEP_FAIL_V1"]

-- compose.bad.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:e2e-no-such-tag-cdepfail
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=CDEP_FAIL_V2"]

-- .env --
